<!-- Programme Section -->
<div class="section section-gray" id="programme">
<div class="container">

<h2 class="section-title">Programme <span>(Praevius Project)</span></h2>

<p class="text-center mb-4" style="max-width: 750px; margin: 0 auto 3rem;">
Plan the job in the same place you track its cost. Praevius Project covers what a construction planner does each week in MS Project or Asta Powerproject: critical path, Gantt, baselines and progress. <strong>Included in every plan</strong>—the plan sets how many programmes, baselines and imports you get.
</p>

<div class="grid-2">

<div class="feature-card">
<h3><i class="bi bi-diagram-3"></i> Critical Path Scheduling</h3>
<p>Dates are calculated by the critical path method on the programme calendar, with working days and exceptions. See straight away which tasks drive your finish date.</p>
<ul style="color: #757575; margin-top: 1rem;">
<li>Critical tasks marked on the Gantt</li>
<li>Total float and free float columns</li>
<li>Finish-to-start, start-to-start, finish-to-finish and start-to-finish links with lags</li>
<li>Deadlines that warn when they are missed</li>
</ul>
</div>

<div class="feature-card">
<h3><i class="bi bi-bar-chart-steps"></i> Gantt and Task Grid</h3>
<p>Build and change the programme quickly, with the mouse or the keyboard.</p>
<ul style="color: #757575; margin-top: 1rem;">
<li>Drag bars on the Gantt to move, resize and link tasks</li>
<li>Task grid with keyboard editing</li>
<li>Edit several tasks in one step</li>
<li>Undo and redo, one change at a time</li>
</ul>
</div>

<div class="feature-card">
<h3><i class="bi bi-list-nested"></i> Structure and Constraints</h3>
<p>Model the programme the way you plan it, from the WBS down to individual milestones.</p>
<ul style="color: #757575; margin-top: 1rem;">
<li>Constraints: as soon as possible, as late as possible, start or finish no earlier or no later than, must start or finish on</li>
<li>Deadlines, milestones and hammock tasks</li>
<li>WBS structure with indent and outdent</li>
<li>Several programmes per project, with one marked current</li>
</ul>
</div>

<div class="feature-card">
<h3><i class="bi bi-flag"></i> Baselines and Progress</h3>
<p>Know where you are against the plan you agreed, and show it clearly at the next progress meeting.</p>
<ul style="color: #757575; margin-top: 1rem;">
<li>Save baselines and compare them with the current programme</li>
<li>Baseline bars and finish variance on the Gantt</li>
<li>Progress by status date, percent complete and actual dates</li>
<li>Progress line that shows tasks behind or ahead</li>
</ul>
</div>

<div class="feature-card">
<h3><i class="bi bi-arrow-left-right"></i> Import and Export</h3>
<p>Bring in the programme you already have and send it back in the format the main contractor uses.</p>
<ul style="color: #757575; margin-top: 1rem;">
<li>Import MS Project .mpp and MSPDI .xml</li>
<li>Import Asta Powerproject .pp and Primavera .xer</li>
<li>A loss report shows what an import or export could not carry</li>
<li>Export MSPDI, XER, PDF (A3) and Excel</li>
</ul>
</div>

<div class="feature-card">
<h3><i class="bi bi-shield-check"></i> Validate</h3>
<p>Check programme quality before you issue it, so logic problems do not reach the client.</p>
<ul style="color: #757575; margin-top: 1rem;">
<li>Open ends</li>
<li>Negative float</li>
<li>Constraints that fight the logic</li>
</ul>
</div>

<div class="feature-card">
<h3><i class="bi bi-chat-dots"></i> Programme AI Assistant</h3>
<p>Type or speak what you need: "add a 3-week task Piling after Excavation" or "how far are we behind baseline B1".</p>
<ul style="color: #757575; margin-top: 1rem;">
<li>17 programme tools</li>
<li>Voice input</li>
<li>Every change is proposed with a preview</li>
<li>Changes apply only after you confirm</li>
</ul>
</div>

<div class="feature-card" id="mcp-server">
<h3><i class="bi bi-plug"></i> Praevius MCP Server: Connect Your Own AI Agent</h3>
<p>Agent Access lets you connect Claude, Cursor or Codex to the Praevius MCP server. You sign in with OAuth and approve the connection in your browser.</p>
<ul style="color: #757575; margin-top: 1rem;">
<li>Read access on every plan, including Free</li>
<li>Write tools on the Professional and Scale plans</li>
<li>Every write is confirmed by you</li>
<li>Revoke access at any time in Settings → Security → Connected agents</li>
</ul>
</div>

</div>

<p class="text-center" style="max-width: 750px; margin: 2rem auto 0; color: #757575;">
<strong>Limits, stated plainly:</strong> the programme has no resource or cost loading. Each programme holds up to 2,000 tasks (150 on the Free plan). <a href="pricing.html">See programme limits by plan</a>.
</p>

</div>
